article.story: POCATELLO, Idaho -- — Gus Etchison's 29 points helped Idaho State defeat Montana 73-69 on Thursday. Etchison also contributed five rebounds for the Bengals (11-17, 4-11 Big Sky Conference). Lachlan Brewer scored 11 points, shooting 5 for 8, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc. Louis Bond had eight points and shot 1 for 5 (0 for 3 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. The Bengals stopped a nine-game skid with the win. Money Williams finished with 19 points, six rebounds and four assists for the Grizzlies (14-13, 8-6). Montana also got 10 points from Brooklyn Hicks. Tyler Thompson also had 10 points. The Bengals were held to three points over the final 4:42, but had built up a seven-point lead before that scoring drught began. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
